# Bitly
> Bitly’s Connections Platform provides URL shortening, branded links, QR Codes, analytics, landing pages, integrations, and developer tools.

Bitly helps businesses create, customize, distribute, and measure links and QR Codes across marketing, social, SMS, and offline channels. Its platform includes product pages, feature overviews, integrations, trust resources, and developer documentation.

## Products
- [URL Shortener](https://bitly.com/pages/products/url-shortener): Create, customize, share, and track shortened links.
- [Analytics](https://bitly.com/pages/products/analytics): Measure link performance from a centralized analytics dashboard.
- [Pages](https://bitly.com/pages/products/pages): Build mobile-friendly, no-code landing pages for campaigns and profiles.

## Features
- [Branded Links](https://bitly.com/pages/features/branded-links): Use custom branded domains to improve recognition and trust.
- [Mobile Links](https://bitly.com/pages/features/mobile-links): Create short links optimized for SMS and mobile engagement.
- [UTM Campaigns](https://bitly.com/pages/features/utm-tracking): Add and manage UTM parameters for links and QR Codes.
- [Trust Center](https://bitly.com/pages/trust): Review Bitly security, privacy, compliance, and trust information.

## Integrations
- [Integrations Marketplace](https://bitly.com/pages/marketplace): Browse available Bitly integrations and connected tools.
- [Bitly Shopify Integration](https://bitly.com/pages/marketplace/shopify): Connect Bitly with Shopify for commerce workflows.
- [Bitly + Canva Integration](https://bitly.com/pages/marketplace/canva): Use Bitly with Canva for shareable branded content.
